title: Regression Bridge: Console-native alerting and dedupe for eval-driven quality changes
creator: Nikhil Shah
description: Build a console-first integration that links eval-detected quality regressions to configuration and model changes and delivers deduplicated alerts to downstream channels (Slack + PagerDuty). The feature should surface correlated change context (model version, config diff, rollout population), allow operators to tune dedupe and grouping windows, and provide an auditable handoff for on-call responders.
acceptance_criteria: Console can generate an alert bundle for an eval regression that includes: failing eval-suite, sample inputs/outputs, model_version, config_hash, rollout_tag, and time of change.
Alerts are routed to Slack channels and PagerDuty with stable fingerprints so repeat noise is deduped within a configurable window.
UI exposes dedupe/grouping controls (window length, grouping keys, inhibition rules) and defaults that follow product policy.
Playbook/runbook link and a one-click Create Incident option in console that opens a pre-populated PagerDuty/Priority ticket.
Dashboard shows a correlation view linking regressions to the most recent model/config change and highlights confidence score for the correlation.
Telemetry is emitted for: alert count, dedupe suppressions, false-positive feedback, alert-to-incident conversion rate, and time-to-acknowledge for PD alerts.
Regression alerts support sticky fallback: when a primary model variant is unavailable, console falls back to a compatible model and includes fallback metadata in the alert.
Security review completed and any customer-facing config fields documented in the Console settings doc.
comments: 2025-02-15 - Nikhil Shah: Initial ticket created after weekly evals review. Observed spike in eval regressions coincident with model rollout; multiple teams received duplicate Slack alerts. Goal: unify routing and dedupe in console.
2025-02-20 - Maria Gomez: Scoped MVP: Slack + PagerDuty only, grouping keys = [model_version, config_hash, eval_suite, dataset], default dedupe window = 4 hours. Added to Cycle 2025-W09.

2025-02-24 - Eng (Ben Liu): Proposed architecture in GH PR: eval-change-detector -> alert-broker -> console-notify. Suggest using Redis for short-lived dedupe index and Postgres for alert history. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4021
2025-02-27 - Design (Clara Ortiz): Shared console mockups for alert configuration screen and correlative timeline. Mock: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ID/Regression+Alerting+UI

2025-02-28 - Maria Gomez: Decided on fingerprinting algorithm: stable hash of (model_version||config_hash||eval_suite||bucket) plus canonicalized change diff id. Avoid using timestamps in fingerprint.
2025-03-03 - Security (Rajat Singh): KMS usage for any alert payloads containing customer PII approved. Sec review required flag set for final release.

2025-03-04 - Eng (Ben Liu): Implemented initial dedupe logic and added metrics. Will run canary for two internal teams next week. Follow-up: add rate-limiting and suppression thresholds to avoid PD storms.
